https://saxobank.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/e.title: KYC Analyst, Saxo Belgium
https://saxobank.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/e.description: Do you enjoy investigating client profiles, assessing financial crime risks and making well-reasoned KYC decisions? Join our growing Belgian business and help protect the integrity of Saxo while creating a smooth experience for our clients. About the job As a regulated investment services provider, knowing our clients is fundamental to how Saxo operates. It enables us to serve clients appropriately while identifying and managing potential financial crime and integrity risks. As a KYC Analyst in our Antwerp office, you will play an important role in onboarding new clients and reviewing existing relationships. You will investigate client profiles, assess source of wealth and source of funds, conduct enhanced due diligence and determine whether identified risks are acceptable within Saxo’s policies and risk appetite. This is not a box-ticking role. You will need to connect information from different sources, distinguish between relevant and non-material findings and document clear, well-reasoned conclusions. At the same time, you will help ensure that legitimate clients can access Saxo’s investment services without unnecessary delays or friction. You will work closely with colleagues across Financial Crime Prevention, the Belgian commercial organisation and Saxo’s international shared services. Together, you will deliver compliant and efficient onboarding and ongoing due diligence processes while maintaining a strong client experience. Responsibilities In this role, you will: Conduct KYC reviews for new and existing private, corporate and institutional clients in line with applicable AML requirements and Saxo’s internal policies. Investigate client ownership structures, source of wealth, source of funds, transaction-related information and other relevant risk indicators. Perform customer risk assessments and enhanced due diligence, documenting clear and well-supported conclusions in English. Identify, investigate and escalate potential AML, financial crime and integrity risks when further review or action is required. Communicate directly with clients to collect and clarify the information needed to complete KYC reviews. Collaborate with Relationship Managers, local KYC colleagues and international shared-service teams to ensure efficient onboarding and ongoing due diligence. Review the quality of work delivered by shared-service teams and provide practical guidance when improvements are needed. Identify recurring quality gaps and contribute to improving KYC controls, processes and ways of working. Support the review and implementation of Saxo’s AML policies, procedures and relevant regulatory requirements. Your profile You are an analytical and responsible KYC professional who is comfortable making decisions based on complex or incomplete information. You approach clients with professionalism and empathy, but you are also confident asking challenging questions when the situation requires it. You can identify what is material from a risk perspective

https://www.airtics.org/how-to-become-a-.description: Written by the Airtics Education academic team · Reviewed by an Airtics program advisor TL;DR: To become a data scientist in the UAE: build core skills (Python, statistics, SQL, machine learning), earn a recognised qualification, build a portfolio of real projects, and network locally. You can do all of this while working full-time. Here’s the step-by-step. Step 1, Learn the core skills Start with Python, statistics, SQL and the fundamentals of machine learning and data visualization. If you’re new to coding, a focused program like Mastering Python for Data Science is a sensible first step. Step 2, Earn a recognised qualification A recognised qualification gets you past the CV screen. Depending on your goal, choose a PG Diploma in Data Science & AI to switch roles quickly, or an online Master’s in Data Science for long-term seniority. Not sure which? See our guide on how to choose the right course . Step 3, Build a portfolio Three to four real projects beat any certificate alone. Use UAE-relevant data, transport, real estate, retail, public services, to show employers you can solve local problems. Step 4, Specialise Generalist data science is competitive. Specialisations like NLP or computer vision face less competition and often pay more. Step 5, Network and apply GITEX, meetups and LinkedIn communities are where UAE roles get filled. For the pay you can expect, see data scientist salaries in the UAE . FAQ How long does it take to become a data scientist? With focused study alongside work, many professionals are job-ready in 9 to 18 months depending on their starting point. Can I become a data scientist without a technical background? Yes, start with foundational Python and statistics, then build up. Many career-switchers in the UAE do exactly this. Ready to start? Talk to an Airtics advisor on WhatsApp or request a callback. Want guidance on your next step? Thinking about upskilling? Tell us your goal and an Airtics advisor will point you to the right program, with no obligation. https://abovedigital.com/career/ghl-auto.title: GHL Automation Architect Full Time Remote
https://abovedigital.com/career/ghl-auto.description: GHL Automation Architect Full Time Remote About This Role This role is about building the automation backbone that helps an agency scale. You will design GoHighLevel systems that speed up lead response, improve conversion, create cleaner sales handoffs, strengthen client reporting, and turn one-off wins into repeatable operating assets. You will be working from an early-stage foundation, which means your thinking will shape the way the business builds, measures, improves, and reuses automation across client accounts. The work calls for deep focus, strong technical judgement, and the ability to turn messy conversion problems into clear workflows, triggers, dashboards, AI agents, and scalable templates. The reward is tangible: your builds will change how leads move, how sales teams follow up, how clients see performance, and how the agency grows. You will have real autonomy, direct access to the founder, and the chance to create systems that become central to the business. The Kind of Person Who Thrives Here You enjoy turning ambiguous business problems into clean technical architecture. You go deep into platform logic, edge cases, testing, and documentation until the system holds up. You think ahead and build in a way that supports scale across future clients and campaigns.
